summary.en: The closing page, flush left: the name at 225 px, three or four parts under 4 px rules, an ink square and the URL at 47 px held at least 3 s, a rule and foot lines; an ink underline lands under the URL on the last downbeat.
summary.zh: 左对齐的落版：225 px 的产品名，4 px 细线下的三四个要点，一个墨色方块和 47 px 的网址（至少停 3 秒），一条细线和页脚；最后一个强拍时网址下落一道墨色下划线。

fits: The last page of a plakat film; any Swiss-style lockup with a URL.
notFor: Logos that must be drawn as artwork; more than four parts; films that end on a question.

intent.en: End on what to type: the name, its parts as a summary, and the URL held long enough to read and remember.
intent.zh: 以“去哪找”收尾：产品名、要点作总结，网址停得够久，读得完也记得住。

content.en: Name (≤ 14 chars), 2–4 parts (≤ 12 chars), URL (code, ≤ 44), 1–2 foot lines (≤ 44).

fits.zh: plakat 片子的最后一页；任何带网址的瑞士风落版。

notFor.zh: 必须画成图形的标志；超过四个要点；以问题结尾的片子。

en: It absorbs the phrase's remainder: a host that cuts it short loses the last-downbeat underline.
zh: 它吸收乐句剩余的长度；宿主把它截短，最后一拍的下划线就没了。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
